name: prepare-reverse-shell
title: Prepare a Reverse Shell
description: Stand up everything needed to catch a shell: a listener, a Linux and a Windows payload crafted for it, and the PTY-upgrade recipe for once it lands. obol never fires the payload — it crafts and stages; you trigger it. Each step runs through the same scope-enforced runner as `obol run`.

steps.label: Start a reverse-shell listener
steps.note: Opens the catcher on an operator/callback port; the crafted payloads point back at it.

steps.label: Craft a Linux reverse-shell payload
steps.note: Renders the one-liner (bash/nc/etc.) targeting the listener — copy it to run on the box; never auto-fired.

steps.label: Craft a Windows reverse-shell payload
steps.note: The Windows equivalent (PowerShell/nc.exe). Skip the OS you don't need — per-step, operator's choice.

steps.label: Upgrade a dumb shell to a full PTY
steps.note: The recipe to turn the caught shell into an interactive TTY (job control, vim, sudo) — for after it lands.
